# About Me

I am a Computer Science graduate with professional experience in logistics, operations, and business administration. My background has given me first-hand experience solving operational challenges, improving customer service, managing teams, and using data to support better business decisions.

After discovering the power of data analytics, I completed the Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate and the Johns Hopkins Data Science Specialization to strengthen my analytical and technical skills.

Today, I combine operational experience with analytics, SQL, R, Python, Excel, Tableau, and machine learning to transform raw business data into actionable insights that improve efficiency, reduce costs, and support smarter decision-making.

My projects demonstrate practical experience in exploratory data analysis, business intelligence dashboards, predictive analytics, machine learning, and operational analytics.
